name: 巡航飞艇

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. One complete chunky miniature cyberpunk rigid airship, elongated nine-unit hull with pointed nose to image right, charcoal armor, warm amber cabin windows, compact underside passenger gondola, solid circular cyan propulsion ring housings at rear, small tail fins. No propeller blur, smoke, stand or dock. Long axis horizontal, side visible. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 完整机头、尾翼、尾部推进环及下吊舱；原模型长轴Z机头+Z，旋转π/2后长轴X机头+X。
